HNGRLANG 1: First Year first quarter Hungarian is the first course in a three quarter sequence. Course emphasizes development of basic level communication skills using daily life topics. Grammatical structures and vocabulary are introduced through interpersonal, interpretive and presentational modes of communication. Hungarian culture.
HNGRLANG 2: Continuation of HNGRLANG 1. First Year second quarter Hungarian is the second course in a three quarter sequence. Course emphasizes further development of basic level communication skills using daily life topics. Grammatical structures and vocabulary are introduced through interpersonal, interpretive and presentational modes of communication. Hungarian culture. Prerequisite: HNGRLANG 1 or placement test
HNGRLANG 3: Continuation of HNGRLANG 2. First Year Third Quarter Hungarian is the third course in a three quarter sequence. Course emphasizes further development of basic level communication skills using daily life topics. Grammatical structures and vocabulary are introduced through interpersonal, interpretive and presentational modes of communication. Hungarian culture. Prerequisite: HNGRLANG 2 or placement test.
HNGRLANG 101: The Third Year Hungarian is a three-quarter sequence. The course integrates language and culture, emphasizing further developing proficiency in interpersonal, interpretive, and presentational communications. Targeted functional abilities include presentational and socio-culturally appropriate language in formal and informal contexts. Prerequisite: HNGRLANG 23 or placement test.

Targeted functional abilities include presentational and socio-culturally appropriate language in formal and informal contexts. Prerequisite: HNGRLANG 101 or placement test.
HNGRLANG 103: The Third Year Hungarian is a three-quarter sequence. The course integrates language and culture, emphasizing further developing proficiency in interpersonal, interpretive, and presentational communications. Targeted functional abilities include presentational and socio-culturally appropriate language in formal and informal contexts. Prerequisite: HNGRLANG 102 or placement test.
HNGRLANG 211: Continuation of HNGRLANG 103. The course is the continuity of three academic years of learning Hungarian or students' ability to prove their proficiency by testing. Learnings will build on the previous quarters, including conversation, writing, reading, and contemporary Hungary's social and cultural issues.
